gap.title: Search: find four independent 4 by 4 complex matrices, with zero row and column sums, spanning a space on which a permanent-type sum stays constant
gap.statement: ∃ L : Submodule ℂ (Fin 4 × Fin 4 → ℂ), (∀ t ∈ L, (∀ i : Fin 4, ∑ j, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∀ j : Fin 4, ∑ i, t (i, j) = 0) ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, if j = l then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, if a < b then t (a, j) * t (b, l) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ l = m then 0 else ∑ a : Fin 4, ∑ b : Fin 4, ∑ c : Fin 4, if a < b ∧ b < c then t (a, j) * t (b, l) * t (c, m) else 0) = 0 ∧ (∑ j, ∑ l, ∑ m, ∑ n, if j = l ∨ j = m ∨ j = n ∨ l = m ∨ l = n ∨ m = n then 0 else t (0, j) * t (1, l) * t (2, m) * t (3, n)) = 0) ∧ Module.finrank ℂ L = 4
gap.unlocks: Needed by seat-rmine-1 and seat-barrier-1 for: the largest doubly centred level space at 4 by 4, open over the complex numbers
gap.context: SEARCH GAP, possibly empty: the witness is an explicit basis, checked by one polynomial identity. Searches over two small prime fields found dimension 3 only; that is evidence, not a proof over the complex numbers. A proof must prove exactly the recorded statement, with no sorry, no new axiom and no native_decide.
